breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains 'noSlip' boundary conditions on front/back patches for all fields (k, epsilon, nut, alphat, U, T, p, p_rgh) and describes front/back as 'walls to enforce 2D behavior.' The ground truth requires front/back patches to be 'empty' type to properly enforce 2D simulation. The agent did not fix this inconsistency.
